sentences.en: The company offers a six-month probationary period to new hires.
sentences.zh: 公司为新员工提供为期六个月的试用期。

sentences.en: During her probationary period, she was observed by three different managers.
sentences.zh: 在她的试用期间，她被三位不同的经理观察过。

sentences.en: He is currently on probationary status after breaking the law.
sentences.zh: 他因违法目前处于缓刑状态。
